name: Tabby
title: tabby.sh
payoff: A terminal for the modern age
shortDescription: Tabby is a modern terminal designed to enhance productivity for developers and IT professionals. It supports multiple platforms including Windows, Mac, and Linux, and integrates features like SSH client, serial terminal, and full Unicode support. Users can manage multiple sessions with ease, customize their environment, and even handle file transfers. Ideal for those who require a robust, customizable terminal experience.
cons: Potential compatibility issues with some plugins
Higher resource usage than some lighter terminals
